intro: Technology and cybersecurity sectors bore the brunt of 63 articles on ai-security published between April 12 and June 25, 2026, with 30 high-severity and 8 critical reports. Threat actors Claude Mythos and OpenClaw were observed, while critical vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-5752 (CVSS 9.3), CVE-2026-44339 (CVSS 8.6), CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 7.7), and CVE-2026-45303 (CVSS 7.7). Impact spanned global, China, North America, and the United States, affecting critical infrastructure, government, and financial services.
